caption: The drawing depicts a small handbag suspended from a long, thin, silver-colored chain strap. The chain is attached to the bag by two metal loops situated at the top corners of the bag, with the strap itself forming a wide inverted "V" shape up to a singular clasp at the top center. The body of the bag is rounded and slightly bulbous, colored in shades of brown and tan, with darker shadows outlining its contours and a subtle highlight indicating a light source from the upper left. The bag has a silver metal frame along its upper edge, and there is a rounded flap that closes with a small, circular metal clasp in the center. The background is a plain, light beige color with slight variations in tone, giving it a textured, parchment-like appearance.
title: Reticule
